t0323-01.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
t0323-01.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a bitter residue while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

t0323-02.gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
t0323-02.rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
